build.buildCommand: python main.py extract && pip install -r requirements.txt

deploy.startCommand: python main.py extract && python manage.py makemigrations store --noinput && python manage.py migrate --noinput && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput && python manage.py ensure_admin && gunicorn config.wsgi --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --workers 3 --timeout 60
